rule: D-LIB8M-TEMPO (lib4-cards.md section 16): the concentric phase takes up, the eccentric takes down; Hold takes pause right after the concentric, only if pause > 0; any other static phase, and a cycle plate's Work and Rest, is a constant only with a quote that states its seconds; a range is the quote's string. Phase names, order and move flags are labels; order follows the drawn order (DESIGN.md section 8 pose map). Proposed: D-LIB22-TEMPO (lib-22-card ruling 25), for 'LB10 NOTE RULED'. No row for the D-LIB22-SECS NOSECS ids (sled_push, sled_pull, farmer_s_carry, burpee, medicine_ball_slam, wall_ball): their tempo is null and no quote states seconds of a drawn phase. Constant rows carry their claim and quote verbatim, as pilot-a/tempo.json @ dcac4a38 does.
